paper_handling: R352 is a profiler-output benchmark audit; it does not support analyst accuracy, time, or productivity claims.
Recursive stack fields and existing labels are evaluated, but the paper does not claim complete automatic boundary discovery.
Trace import/export examples remain artifact-level exchange evidence, not full OpenTelemetry/Phoenix/LangSmith/Langfuse/Perfetto compatibility.
R349 exact action transfer remains 7/60 and non-default exact action remains 2/42.

The main label-scored claim uses six tasks from four oracle-rich families; broader tool/API/mobile coverage remains optional future generality.
